stories.title: Students showcasing their artificial intelligence creations are imagining, and shaping, a new world
stories.simple_summary: Young students are creating and showing off their AI projects. These projects are exploring ideas about what the future could look like.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly inspiring to see what young people are thinking about — not something that affects your daily life right now.

stories.title: ‘Everything about me is good in his eyes’: the women in China choosing AI boyfriends over human men
stories.simple_summary: Some women in China are using AI chatbots designed to act like boyfriends instead of dating real people. The AI tells them nice things and keeps them company.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows people are finding new ways to use AI, though it's mostly a personal choice story rather than something affecting your business or finances.

stories.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
stories.simple_summary: A big investment company is raising money very quickly to invest in AI businesses in India. They collected $550 million in just weeks.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and big business people — it doesn't affect ordinary folks or small shops.

stories.title: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT (an AI chatbot made by OpenAI) and Gemini (Google's AI chatbot) have each reached 1 billion people using them every month. That's a huge number of users.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows these AI tools are now used by a lot of regular people worldwide, so they're becoming more important to understand the basics of.

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is making a special ChatGPT app for Linux computers. Linux is a different type of operating system (like Windows or Mac) that some people use.
stories.why_it_matters: Unless you use Linux computers, this doesn't affect you — it's just making the software available to more technical computer users.

stories.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
stories.simple_summary: Google's Gemini AI chatbot now has 1 billion monthly users. Most of them talk to it using their voice, and it creates over 150 million pictures every day.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows Google's AI is being used heavily for everyday tasks like voice chat and creating images — good to know these tools exist if you ever want to try them.

stories.title: Another OpenAI executive takes off
stories.simple_summary: Brad Lightcap, who has worked at OpenAI for 8 years and was a top manager there, announced he's leaving to start something new.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to investors and tech industry watchers — staff changes at tech companies don't usually affect small business owners or customers.

stories.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
stories.simple_summary: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI's longtime top operations manager, is leaving the company to work on something else.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to tech investors and industry followers — not something that changes how you'd use AI tools.

stories.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
stories.simple_summary: A brand new startup called River AI just received $1.1 billion in funding after only being around for 2 months. They want to build personal AI agents that help individual people.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mostly to investors — it shows a lot of money is flowing into AI startups, but it doesn't affect your current life.

stories.title: Made by Google 2026: all the Pixel news and announcements
stories.simple_summary: Google is getting ready to announce new Pixel phone models on August 12th. The phones might have new colors and special lights on the fancy models.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're thinking about buying a new Android phone, this is worth watching for the new features and options Google will offer.

stories.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (an AI company) created an AI that made surprising progress on a super-difficult math problem that experts have been stuck on for over 150 years. They didn't solve it completely, but got further than expected.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly important to mathematicians and researchers — it shows AI is getting better at hard thinking tasks, but it won't affect your daily life.

stories.title: Apple could help you prove your iPhone photos aren’t deepfakes
stories.simple_summary: Apple is working on a new iPhone feature that proves your photos really came from your iPhone camera and weren't faked with AI. It would stamp information onto your photos when you take them.
stories.why_it_matters: This could become useful if you ever need to prove a photo is real and not a fake created by AI — handy for protecting your photos' credibility.
